verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Praying for a miracle
Thirsty for the living well
Only You can satisfy

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:

Now I’ve tasted it’s not hard to see
Only You can satisfy

There’s honey in the rock

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:

Now that I know
Everything I need You’ve got
There's honey in the rock
